# Local PDF runtime

pdfmake 0.2.23, copied unchanged from the npm package `pdfmake@0.2.23`:
- `build/pdfmake.min.js`
- `build/vfs_fonts.js`

Loaded only when the visitor creates a PDF. The virtual filesystem embeds Roboto fonts, including Cyrillic. No CDN, font server, upload API or external service is used by the export flow.

pdfmake: MIT, see LICENSE. Source: https://github.com/bpampuch/pdfmake/tree/0.2

Roboto: SIL Open Font License 1.1, see OFL.txt. Copyright 2011 The Roboto Project Authors (https://github.com/googlefonts/roboto-classic).

Documentation: https://pdfmake.github.io/docs/0.1/getting-started/client-side/
